cd /workspace && cat > tmp/max2.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, sys
rng = random.Random(5)
C,E,K,F,W,S,L = 8,4,5,8,16,256,4
NCONN = 16
NPKT = 20000
doc = {"version":1,
 "config":{"slots":S,"window":W,"idle_timeout":10**12,"len_quantum":1,"gap_quantum":1,
   "rate_num":10**6,"rate_den":1,"bucket_capacity":512,"initial_tokens":512,
   "pending_capacity":512,"lanes":L,"service":[1]*C,"fallback":C-1,
   "time_edges":[0],"count_edges":[0],"probability":[[65536]]},
 "model":{"classes":C,"embedding_dim":E,
   "length_embedding":[[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
   "gap_embedding":[[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
   "kernel":K,
   "conv_weights":[[[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(2*E)] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],
   "conv_bias":[rng.randint(-2**31,2**31-1) for _ in range(F)],
   "conv_shift":[rng.randint(0,16) for _ in range(F)],
   "dense_weights":[[rng.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(F)] for _ in range(C)],
   "dense_bias":[rng.randint(-2**31,2**31-1) for _ in range(C)]},
 "connections":[{"id":"c"*32,"%s":"x"} for _ in range(0)],
 "packets":[]}
doc["connections"] = [{"id":("id-%02d_"%i)+"x"*26,"slot":i,"label":i%C,"split":"dev" if i%2 else "eval"} for i in range(NCONN)]
for k in range(NPKT):
    doc["packets"].append({"time":k,"connection":doc["connections"][k%NCONN]["id"],
        "length":rng.randrange(65536),"draw":rng.randrange(65536)})
json.dump(doc, open(sys.argv[1],"w"))
print("input bytes", len(open(sys.argv[1]).read()))
PYEOF
python3 tmp/max2.py tmp/max2.json && time python3 submission/main.py < tmp/max2.json > tmp/max2_out.json && ls -l tmp/max2_out.json && python3 -c '
import json,collections
o=json.load(open("tmp/max2_out.json"))
print("jobs",len(o["jobs"]), collections.Counter(p["decision"] for p in o["packets"]), collections.Counter(j["status"] for j in o["jobs"]))
print("max logits digits", max(max(len(str(abs(v))) for v in j["logits"]) for j in o["jobs"]))'
